text:
ana: noticing a small but steady bump in schema.validation.rejects for fncall.tool-adapter in eu-west after enabling strict output schemas. Rejects ~0.6% over 10m. Anyone on-call?

mike: on it. quick sample from logs: {error:EVAL_401, path:response.results[0], expected:object, got:string, raw:\"ok\"} 
 Looks like an adapter returned a compact key list instead of objects.

sylvia: adapter change rolled yesterday to reduce payload size. they returned strings when values empty. validator now rejects.

ana: (typo) ana: options: 1) rollback strict schema (heavy) 2) route failing traffic to permissive variant with soft-fail telemetry 3) hotfix shim in runtime to coerce string->object for empty-case.

mike: prefer 2) or 3). If we route to permissive, console/finance need visibility and billing treatment.

console-team: UX ask: show a per-route mitigation banner when permissive/soft-coerce is active, expose a small inspector diff (before/after) for sampled requests, and surface `coercion_count` as a column in the route table.

ops-bot: Alert: validation.reject rate > 0.5% on fncall.tool-adapter (eu-west) 
 incident INC-8342 created.

finance: billing note: we don't want customers billed for platform coercions. prefer tagging affected requests as `billing_review` and producing a daily CSV. auto-unbillable only for short emergency windows (<4h) with ops approval.

sylvia: I'll push a runtime shim that wraps strings -> {key:string} for that adapter and emit telemetry tag `soft_coerce=shim`. Hotfix PR #620. ETA 18m.

mike: while shim lands I propose a routeOverride to permissive-v1 for eu-west (duration 2h) with telemetryTags [\"permissive_hotfix\",\"billing_review\"], sample 200 payloads/hr, retention 48h.

ana: (typo) ana: sample override snippet: 
```nrouteOverrides:
- route: fncall.tool-adapter
  duration: 2h
  action: set_variant
  variant: permissive-v1
  telemetryTags: [\"permissive_hotfix\",\"billing_review\"]
  sampleLogging: 200
```n
console-team: will add banner: \"Permissive fallback active for fncall.tool-adapter (eu-west) - billing_review applied\" and a link to INC-8342. We'll also add a small tile correlating `coercion_count` with `adapter_name`.

ops-bot: Update: permissive-v1 applied to eu-west canary at 07:22 UTC. Reject rate down ~72% in 12m.

sylvia: shim PR merged and deployed to adapters canary. monitoring for 30m.

mike: action items: 1) sylvia - confirm adapter fix across regions 2) console-team - keep banner until adapters fixed 3) finance - prepare CSV export for billing_review requests 4) ana - pause main strict rollout for fncall.tool-adapter until retro.

finance: acknowledged. BILL-178 created for CSV exports and manual adj workflow.

ana: (typo) ana: thanks all. I'll close when metrics stable for 1h. :thumbsup:
